description:
Build the course for deployment. Runs the Vite production build.

Returns:
- success: boolean
- format: LMS format used
- outputDir: path to built output
- errors: any build errors
- warnings: any build warnings
- duration: build time

Use in Stage 5 when the course is ready for export.

format.description: LMS format: cmi5, scorm2004, scorm1.2, or lti (default: cmi5)

name: coursecode_build
